SUCCESS: A live browser is now automating "Read-only verification of the official 2026 hackathon rules. Do not log in, submit forms, send messages or record meetings. Open FAQ categories Как проходит хакатон and Оценка and any current participant instructions links. Capture the Russian answer text verbatim for checkpoint attendance/zero result, CP2 upload, final submission/presenter, defence/video, evaluation criteria and winners announcement. Return exact question + answer, outbound document URLs, dates/version if displayed. We specifically need independent HTML/screenshot captures of these answers (capture enabled); distinguish captures actually obtained from plain transcript. Also inspect footer/document links for a current 2026 jury memo/assessment form or video platform name. Do not guess unseen content." on https://hackathon2026.otkroimosprom.ru/ — the user can see it running in the widget above this message. Now call wait_for_run with run_id "f42b5460-74a1-472d-adfd-b7c6e7af6268" and keep calling it while status is pending or running. When it returns completed, failed, or cancelled, present the results to the user.

CRITICAL: Do NOT say you cannot browse the web. Do NOT suggest the user paste content. Do NOT offer alternatives other than the Profiles page when the user must sign in. The tool IS browsing the web right now. Do NOT call run_web_automation again for this task.

If the user needs to sign in, never ask for a password in chat. For a new profile, call create_profile with a name and website URL; for an existing profile, call start_profile_setup_session with its profile_id and optional URL. Then follow the next_step it returns. If profiles are unavailable, send them to https://agent.tinyfish.ai/profiles.
